# Big Data Intelligence Hub

> AI-curated daily intelligence on the modern big data ecosystem — Apache Spark, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS EMR, Google BigQuery, and Databricks.

## Pages

- [Daily Brief](/): Today's top insight, highlights, emerging trends, and strategic impact.
- [News Feed](/news): Latest articles from Databricks, Apache, AWS, Google, and Microsoft, grouped by day.
- [Ecosystem Trends](/trends): Biggest shift today, fastest growing technologies, vendor momentum, emerging signals, and declining topics.
